column3: Design comp for a website preloader screen, full frame: deep petrol-teal water seen from just below the surface, a single dye-magenta plastic bottle cap floating at the centre catching the light, faint rings spreading on the surface above, lots of calm empty space around it for a thin progress count. Quiet, still, anticipatory.

Design comp for the first scene of a scroll-story website: a muddy river bank in cool early-morning light with tall reeds in the foreground, a single clear plastic drinks bottle with a dye-magenta cap tipping off the bank into a slow river current; the river flows toward a distant estuary and open sea on the horizon. The left third stays calm and empty for a headline laid over later. Deep layered depth: far hills, mid river, near bank, foreground reeds.

Design comp for a scroll-story scene about plastic breaking apart: a split view at the waterline of a bright sunlit sea, above the line a wave crest, below it the plastic bottle cracking into angular shards that scatter into smaller and smaller fragments trailing diagonally down and to the right, some fragments yellowing to oxidised amber. The right third stays calmer for text. Layered depth with particles at three distances.

Design comp for a scroll-story scene about ocean currents: the open ocean seen from high above at a slight angle, sweeping curved current lines painted as pale sea-glass streaks across deep petrol water, tiny magenta and amber plastic fragments riding along the streaks in long arcs toward the horizon. Empty calm space on the left for a headline. Layered: clouds near the camera, the sea surface, the current lines.

Design comp for a scroll-story scene about an ocean gyre garbage patch: a vast slow spiral of the ocean seen from straight above, the swirl of currents painted in sea glass on petrol teal, and toward its calm centre thousands of tiny plastic fragments in dye magenta, oxidised amber and bleached bone gathering into a faint haze, no big trash piles. Off-centre composition with the eye of the spiral at two-thirds right.

Design comp for a scroll-story scene about the deep sea and the food chain: a vertical journey from a dim blue mid-water layer with a school of small silver fish, a sea turtle and a jellyfish, down to a dark petrol seafloor of soft sediment; tiny plastic fragments drifting down like marine snow, a few amber fragments near the mouth of a fish. God-rays fading from the top. Space on the left for text.

Design comp for an interactive web page: a large stylised globe of the Earth on the right half seen from space, oceans painted in deep petrol teal with pale sea-glass current streamlines wrapping around the basins, continents as flat matte foam-paper colour like a nautical chart, a small cloud of glowing magenta-to-amber dots spreading from one point in the North Pacific. The left side is quiet dark petrol space for a control panel. No text, no UI elements drawn.

Design comp for an interactive map page of a river delta: a flat top-down nautical-chart style view of a large river mouth flowing into a strait between a coastal city on the right and mountainous islands on the left, water in sea glass and petrol teal with fine tidal current hatching, land as flat matte foam-paper with subtle relief shading, a plume of tiny magenta and amber dots fanning out from the river mouth into the strait. No text, no labels.

Design comp for a calm explanatory web section about ocean science: on the right, a scientific surface drifter buoy (a small round float with a long tether down to a cylindrical holey-sock drogue underwater) painted as a natural-history plate, cut away at the waterline to show above and below; the left two-thirds is calm flat petrol-teal water for long text. Quiet and precise.

Wide background plate, no subject: a cool early-morning sky over a flat distant estuary horizon, pale foam and sea-glass bands of cloud, a thin line of far blue hills at the bottom fifth. Opaque, full bleed, nothing in the foreground.

A long horizontal strip of distant rolling hills and a few far conifer trees as one flat silhouette band across the full width, sea-glass and deep sea tones with atmospheric haze. Transparent background PNG (alpha) above and below the strip. One subject only, nothing else in the frame.

A wide horizontal band of slow river water surface seen at a low angle, gentle ripples and soft reflections of a pale sky, spanning the full width, edges soft. Transparent background PNG (alpha) above and below the band. Nothing else in the frame.

A muddy grassy river bank seen from the side as a foreground ground band spanning the full width, sloping down toward the water on the right, wet mud, short grass, a few pebbles. Transparent background PNG (alpha) above. One subject only, nothing else in the frame.

A tall clump of river reeds and cattails, very close foreground, slightly out of focus at the tips, deep sea and petrol tones in shadow. Transparent background PNG (alpha). One subject only, centred, nothing else in the frame, no ground.
Wide background plate, no subject: the sunlit sea surface seen from just below, bright sea-glass light rippling through the surface, fading to deep sea toward the bottom. Opaque, full bleed.

A single long breaking wave crest seen from the side, foam curling over, spanning the full width as a band. Transparent background PNG (alpha) above and below. One subject only, nothing else in the frame.

A scatter of eight separate broken shards of clear PET plastic bottle, angular curved pieces of different sizes, one piece of a dye-magenta cap, two pieces yellowed to oxidised amber, each piece clearly separated from the others with space between. Transparent background PNG (alpha). Nothing else in the frame.
Wide background plate, no subject: the open ocean seen from above at a slight angle, deep petrol water to a soft hazy horizon under a pale sky. Opaque, full bleed, nothing in it.
A few soft wispy low clouds seen from above, scattered across the frame, foam white with sea-glass shadows. Transparent background PNG (alpha). Nothing else.
Long soft underwater god-rays of light falling from the top edge and fading out toward the bottom, sea-glass light only. Transparent background PNG (alpha). Nothing else in the frame.

A huge slow spiral swirl of ocean current seen from straight above, painted as pale sea-glass streak lines curling into a calm centre, tiny dye-magenta, oxidised amber and bleached bone plastic specks gathered toward the centre. Transparent background PNG (alpha) outside the swirl. One subject only.
Wide background plate, no subject: the deep sea floor, soft dark petrol sediment with gentle undulations, a faint dim glow from far above, nothing else. Opaque, full bleed.

A sparse scatter of marine snow: hundreds of tiny pale flakes and specks drifting at different sizes, foam and sea glass, a few tiny amber and magenta plastic specks among them. Transparent background PNG (alpha). Nothing else.

A school of about thirty small silver anchovy-like fish swimming together to the left in a loose oval shoal, as dark sea silhouettes with a little sea-glass sheen. Transparent background PNG (alpha). One subject only, nothing else in the frame.

A single green sea turtle swimming to the left, seen from the side and slightly below, as a deep sea silhouette with soft sea-glass light on its shell. Transparent background PNG (alpha). One subject only, centred, nothing else in the frame.
A single moon jellyfish drifting upward with long trailing tentacles, translucent foam and sea glass. Transparent background PNG (alpha). One subject only, centred, nothing else in the frame.

A single Laysan albatross gliding with long straight wings, seen from below and slightly to the side, foam white and petrol. Transparent background PNG (alpha). One subject only, centred, nothing else in the frame.

A single humpback whale swimming slowly to the right with long pectoral fins, a deep petrol silhouette with faint sea-glass light along its back. Transparent background PNG (alpha). One subject only, centred, nothing else in the frame.

A scatter of eight separate torn pieces of thin plastic bag film, crinkled and translucent, bleached bone and faint magenta, each piece separated from the others with space between. Transparent background PNG (alpha). Nothing else in the frame.

A scatter of eight separate short tangled lengths of synthetic fishing line and rope fibres, dye magenta and amber monofilament and frayed bits, each separated from the others with space between. Transparent background PNG (alpha). Nothing else in the frame.

A scatter of twelve separate small plastic pre-production pellets (nurdles), lentil-shaped, bleached bone and yellowed oxidised amber, one magenta, each separated from the others with space between. Transparent background PNG (alpha). Nothing else in the frame.

A scatter of ten separate tiny elongated tyre-wear particles, dark rubbery sausage-shaped crumbs with mineral bits stuck to them, each separated from the others with space between. Transparent background PNG (alpha). Nothing else in the frame.

A single crumpled thin plastic carrier bag floating, translucent bleached bone with a faint magenta stripe, handles visible. Transparent background PNG (alpha). One subject only, centred, nothing else in the frame.
A single loose coil of tangled dye-magenta nylon fishing line with a small hook. Transparent background PNG (alpha). One subject only, centred, nothing else in the frame.

A single worn car tyre seen at three-quarter view, dark petrol rubber with a dusty bloom of tiny crumbs falling from its tread. Transparent background PNG (alpha). One subject only, centred, nothing else in the frame.

A single scientific surface drifter buoy: a small round float sphere on the surface with a long thin tether down to a cylindrical holey-sock drogue, shown as one vertical object, foam and sea glass with a magenta stripe on the float. Transparent background PNG (alpha). One subject only, centred, nothing else in the frame.
A seamless tileable texture of fine matte gouache paper grain in very light foam colour, subtle and even, no features. Opaque, full bleed.
A seamless tileable texture of a stylised ocean surface seen from directly above, soft painted ripples in petrol teal and deep sea, very even, no features. Opaque, full bleed.
